letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. has commissioned a new automatic moulding line that doubles its capacity for stainless castings.
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH has fixed its electricity supply for 2026-2028 under a long-term contract, the company said.

The start-up of the new moulding line at Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. has run over budget; its house bank has cut the company's credit line, a regional business paper reports. Customers are being asked for faster payment.
A heating manufacturer has moved its cast housings to an Eastern European foundry; Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH loses about a fifth of its turnover from January.

Dear Sir or Madam,

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
